holdings.text: The prosecution is not ab initio void due to absence of prior direction under s.237(1); the complaint by the liquidator suffers from no infirmity making proceedings null and void.

Before this order made by Bannerji J. there was an order of Bachawat J. dated January 15, 1951, under s. 179 and, therefore, when the liquidator authorised his Assistant, respondent No. 1 to institute the proceedings he was entitled to do so.
